decision: 12 (2026-10-15, dec-e70592): put the orphaned channel-layer files behind an off-by-default feature, the way 9201 parked the other subsystems the plan path never uses
method: Lines of the .rs files the feature gates as a whole (wc -l, tests included), at the commit above, before the change that gates them.
default_build_change: None. Since 9c6ec420c (2026-09-25) these files sat outside every module tree, so no build compiled them. The 9201 features took compiled code out of the default build; this one brings code that was never compiled into an opt-in build, where CI's parked-feature step checks it.
not_counted: roko-runtime's other channel-layer files from 9c6ec420c (command_dispatcher.rs, delivery.rs, message_audit.rs, message_formatter.rs, notification_batcher.rs, webhook_dead_letter.rs, webhook_metrics.rs: 2,184 lines) and roko-serve's routes/platforms.rs (109 lines), which stay outside the module tree: gap-092d24
roko-runtime's snapshot_checkpoint.rs (309 lines), also outside the module tree but StateHub code, not channel code: gap-d4da60

cargo_tree_normal_deps.command: cargo tree -p roko-runtime -e normal --prefix none | sort -u | wc -l, then the same with --features channels

cold_build_seconds.command: cargo build -p roko-runtime (cold, idle machine), then the same with --features channels

pending: The cold-build timings need an idle machine. The worker that wrote this file ran every cargo command under the shared heavy.sh limiter alongside other builds, so the timings are null.
conclusion: The channels feature gates 2,900 lines (0.2% of 1,336,452 tracked .rs lines) that no build compiled before. With it on they compile, and their 81 tests (67 in roko-runtime, 14 in roko-core) pass, at the cost of two crates in roko-runtime's dependency tree (futures, futures-executor). The default build is unchanged.
